turnHint: Turns a tall hall a quarter so it fills a wide box (and the other way round). Leaves out the background picture, power, Wi-Fi and cables while turned.
noViews: This hall has no shared saved views yet. Save one on the floor plan with Saved views ▾.
onProblem: When a seat gets a problem
onProblemHint: Show it next: the rows around the seat are the next stop (the spotlight stays there while the problem lasts).
viewGone: This saved view is gone, or only its owner can see it.
noStops: This tour has no stops in this hall.

showsHint.area: The whole hall, a block, a row, a zone or a box you pick below.
showsHint.view: A view saved on the floor plan (Saved views ▾): where it looks and its seat filter.
showsHint.tour: Goes through the stops below, a few seconds each. Touching the screen pauses it for a minute.
showsHint.spotlight: The whole area on the left, colour only, and the stops below zoomed in on the right. Needs a wide box; a narrow one shows the area.
